outcome_evidence: The robot approaches the blue cube in frames 6–16 and closes its fingers around it in frames 17–24, as shown in exterior_image_1_left and wrist_image_left. In frames 28–33, exterior_image_1_left shows the cube lifted clear of the black surface, while wrist_image_left shows it retained between the fingers. No failed acquisition or unintended side effect is established.
